posts.text: Renting in Toronto is tough, and the first time renters usually learned the rules the hard way. At Hack the Valley, my teammates and I built Rentin’ ToRentino to solve this problem. Rentin’ ToRentino turns the Toronto rental landscape into a fully interactive game, including spotting scam listings, decision making for rent/commute compromise, and simulated negotiation with landlords.
